decisions.reason: As a visible multi-title illustrated series that builds on the core offer and supports the firm's publicly stated broadening strategy, management is likely to stay committed and treat any weaker traction as temporary.

The jazz reissue vinyl LP fits the firm's reissue capabilities and genre expansion goals, so despite being easier to discontinue than a larger line, management would still tend to continue it in a growing physical-media market.
A multi-disc box set involves comparatively high preparation and reputational commitment in a format closely tied to the firm's collector-focused identity, which makes withdrawal less likely.

This compilation CD appears less distinctive and less visibly central than the other launches, so management is more likely to reallocate resources from it to the established business or newer development projects.
